messages:
jen: Heads-up — planning a catalog cutover for halcyon-3b-v2 in the next change window. Need consensus on pinning behavior, drain/evict timing, and fallback ordering before we flip. Target window: Tue 2025-05-06 02:00-03:00 UTC. @mike @taylor can you weigh in?

mike: +1 on the window. quick q: what initial traffic % for the canary? and SLO/rollback thresholds?

jen: thinking 10% canary for 30m, then 50% for 30m, then full if green. Rollback triggers: p95 latency > 1200ms sustained for 5m OR error-rate > 1% for 5m OR regen-quality drop > 1.5% on eval suite.

taylor: noted. ops concerns: EU customers need to stay pinned to halcyon-3b-v1 for the first hour post-cutover for compliance checks. Can we do region-aware pinning?

jen: yes — regional pin for EU for 60m then allow routing. We'll include that in the rollout config.

deploy-bot: preflight checks started for halcyon-3b-v2 canary (commit: 64a8f2c).

deploy-bot: preflight result: PASS — model artifacts verified, quant artifacts present, perf smoke ok.

ops-bot: scheduled change window created: 2025-05-06T02:00:00Z — 2025-05-06T03:00:00Z. Paging policy: on-call will be paged for >3x error-rate spike or controller panics.

mike: Suggest default drain timeout = 300s, eviction grace = 900s. That gives time for in-flight KV cache flush and avoids noisy rollbacks. Also add a 2-min safety cooldown between canary jump stages.

jen: sounds good. I'll add to rollout plan. Also proposing fallback ordering for the catalog entry: 1) halcyon-3b-v2-quant128, 2) halcyon-3b-v2-quant8, 3) halcyon-1.5b-v3 (smaller cheaper), 4) gpt-compatible-legacy (last-resort). Any objections?

sara: prefer we put a quality weight so that metrics prefer v2-quant128 over v2-quant8 when both are available. if cost delta is small, keep higher-quality first.

mike: agree. We should encode quality_priority and cost_threshold in fallback policy. Also make EU pin explicit in the routing rule.

jen: adding a short snippet of the rollout YAML we'll commit to the catalog (keeps simple):
```yaml
catalog_entry: halcyon-3b
variants:
  - id: v2-quant128
    priority: 100
  - id: v2-quant8
    priority: 80
  - id: v1-1_5b
    priority: 60
  - id: legacy-gpt
    priority: 10
rollout:
  canary_percent: 10
  canary_duration_min: 30
  stage_increments: [50, 100]
  regional_pin:
    eu: duration_min: 60
  drain_seconds: 300
  eviction_seconds: 900
  rollback_triggers:
    p95_latency_ms: 1200
    error_rate_percent: 1.0
    eval_quality_drop_percent: 1.5
```

taylor: looks good. I'll author the PR with that YAML and link the deploybot job to run the staged rollout.

jen: who signs off on final flip to 100%? recommend product + infra (mike + sara) after stable telemetry for the full 60m at 50%.

mike: I can sign after the 50% stage is clean for 60m.

sara: I'll sign for product; also will prepare a brief release note with risk callouts and a rollback runbook.

deploy-bot: queued rollout job #20250506-17. Will start canary at 2025-05-06T02:05:00Z pending manual approval.

jen: approve to proceed with queued job. @taylor kick it off at +5m during the window.

taylor: will do. I'll monitor traces and cost telemetry. If anything noisy, I'll cut to 0% and call rollback. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: reminder: create an incident channel if rollback happens. Use prefix #inc-halcyon-cutover and summon infra/eng-sre.

mike: one last ask — add a short live-check in the canary that verifies top-5 user flows haven't regressed using the smoke prompts set. If that fails, auto-scale down canary to 0%.

jen: adding that to the PR. thanks everyone — will post the PR link + deploy job number when created.

(timeline note) jen: PR: github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/pull/487 — contains rollout YAML + release note. deploy job #20250506-17 queued.
